pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hybrid hotel in Lyon’s 7th arrondissement, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and a game zone.

Family and budget stay

Choose a private family room for your household and confirm its exact beds, occupancy and any cot requirements. The guest kitchen offers an option for preparing simple meals, while the shared game zone and common areas provide space outside the bedroom.

The hotel is south of the central peninsula in the 7th arrondissement. Allow travel time to your chosen sights and compare the private-room total with taxes, breakfast, parking and other extras. A shared dorm-bed price is a different booking product.

Opening

Covivio announced 1 December 2019 as the Lyon Centre Berthelot opening date. Contemporaneous coverage on 2 December reported the new Lyon launch.

The operator’s launch account records 169 rooms and 590 beds. These are launch figures. No hotel-specific construction investment is assigned from the separate Paris hotel project.

THE TIMES | THE COOL HOTEL GUIDE: YOTEL EDINBURGH

pin.longFormSummary:
A compact city hotel on Queen Street in Edinburgh’s New Town, with a gym and a bar and lounge, suited to travellers comparing practical city bases.

Compact city base

The current room list describes the Premium Queen as 16 m² for up to two guests and the Premium Family as 22 m² for up to four. Choose the actual room type and layout for your party. The hotel also lists a gym and Revolve, its ground-floor bar and lounge.

The Times’ 2019 hosted-stay review highlighted the location and staff, while noting that some smaller rooms route guests through the bathroom area to reach the bed. Check the current room layout and privacy arrangements. Historic review prices and menus are not current offers.

Compare the total for your dates, room category, breakfast and extras. The budget collection does not guarantee a low price during festivals or other high-demand dates.

Opening

The operating company’s filed annual accounts state that YOTEL Edinburgh opened on 5 August 2019. This is the trading opening recorded by the operator.
